{
  "dataset_name": "kr_vs_kp",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "white_king_safety_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite safety indicator for white king position based on overlap, position, and non-check status.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth linear projection summarizing white king safety; useful for SVM margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(wkovl == 't', 1.0, -1.0) + np.where(wkpos == 't', 1.0, -1.0) + np.where(wknck == 't', -1.0, 1.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "black_king_threat_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Aggregate threat indicators against black king (blocks, near-edge, square attacks).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous severity summing multiple black-king vulnerability flags for linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(bkblk == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bknwy == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkon8 == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkona == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkxbq == 't', 1.0, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "white_attack_pressure",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of white piece attacking/threatening indicators on key squares.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides linear separation in attack strength; useful for SVM hyperplane.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(rimmx == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(rxmsq == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(qxmsq == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(skrxp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(rkxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "pawn_promotion_pressure",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicators related to pawn near promotion squares for both sides.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregated pawn-race severity; smooth continuous input for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(bkxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(blxwp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wkna8 == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bxqsq == 't', 1.0, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "katri_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of katri (king-attack tri-state): n=0, w=1, b=-1.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compact ordinal signed projection of 3-level categorical for linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(katri == 'w', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(katri == 'b', -1.0, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "wtoeg_signed",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed encoding of wtoeg: n=0, t=1 indicating tempo/edge status.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct linear contribution for tempo distinction.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(wtoeg == 't', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dwipd_signed",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed encoding of dwipd (distance/win-in-position depth): l=0, g=1.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single-direction linear input separating depth states.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(dwipd == 'g', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "rare_critical_flags",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of rare but potentially decisive flags (head check, stalemate, threatening skewer, knight skewer-check, mate-in-one chain).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures rare high-impact endgame conditions in single linear-friendly score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(hdchk == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(stlmt == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(thrsk == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(skach == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(mulch == 't', 1.0, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "position_complexity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Inverse-simplicity composite: high when position is complex (simpl=f) and context-dependent.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth signed complexity indicator complementing other features in linear projection.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(simpl == 't', -1.0, 1.0) + np.where(cntxt == 't', 1.0, -1.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "white_advantage_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of white-favorable flags over total active flags involving white and black, smoothed.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized continuous score ideal for linear SVM kernel-free margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(wkovl == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wkpos == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(wkcti == 't', 1.0, 0.0)) / (3.0 + np.where(bkblk == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkxbq == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(bkxcr == 't', 1.0, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "defensive_resource_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of defensive resources available (responses for king-defender, opposition, residual squares).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous defensive-resource counter for SVM linear boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(reskd == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(reskr == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(dsopp == 't', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(r2ar8 == 't', 1.0, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "tactical_imbalance_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of tactical imbalance: scaled difference between aggregate white attacking pressure and aggregate black defensive/king-safety conditions normalized to [-1,1].",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth signed margin-like input estimating tactical asymmetry useful for linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
